homeWarranty.reason: Adversarial accuracy audit: HomeWarrantyYN absent/masked at our feed level; MV 100% null — a guaranteed-zero filter.

laundryFeatures.reason: laundry_features carried zero values across all 9,663 on-market listing_search_mv rows — the field could never match a listing and the sheet always hid it.

parkingTotal.reason: Adversarial accuracy audit: no ParkingTotal field at our Spark feed access level; MV column 100% null.

schoolDistrict.reason: Adversarial accuracy audit: every non-null school_district MV value was the mask marker '********' — the feed does not license SchoolDistrict. The elementary/middle/high school NAME filters remain (those columns carry real values).

spa.reason: Adversarial accuracy audit: SpaYN absent/masked at our feed level; MV 100% null. Buyer intent survives via exteriorFeatures/interiorFeatures 'Spa/Hot Tub' (605 live rows), which carry the moved voice phrases.

storiesTotal.reason: Adversarial accuracy audit: Spark masks StoriesTotal at our feed access level ('********' on every row); MV column 100% null. Buyer intent survives via levelsOptions (Levels).

utilitiesConnected.reason: Not a mask-dead removal: group:Utilities is DISPOSITIONED, not dropped. Its four '* Connected' members ship as additional options on the existing `utilities` field (see optionAllowlist.utilities) because the MV v4 column unions the RESO feature object with the CF group. A separate `utilitiesConnected` filter would split one buyer question — 'what utilities does this property have' — across two controls, so the concept is marked handled here rather than left unmapped in the long-tail ledger.

walkScore.reason: Adversarial accuracy audit: no Walk Score field exists at our Spark feed access level; MV column 100% null — a guaranteed-zero filter. Re-add only if the feed changes AND observed coverage is nonzero.

estCompletionYear.resolutionReason: Custom field 'Estimated Completion Date' (a YYYY-MM-DD string on 562 serving rows), projected to its YEAR in the MV. The registry's range plumbing is numeric on both sides, and a year is the honest granularity for 'when can I move in' — the rows carry stale past dates back to 2020, which sort below the current year rather than being rewritten against the clock (MV determinism, F7). MV v4 tranche 2026-07-31.

multiUnitFeatures.resolutionReason: The CF group is bare 'Additional Features'; its members are income-property building features (separate meters, laundry facility, common area), so the registry key names the audience. The 'Kitchen' member is omitted from the option set — its flat payload key is shared with the Rooms group. prevListPrice.resolutionReason: MV column is `prev_list_price`; Spark's standard name is PreviousListPrice.

pricePerAcre.resolutionReason: The MLS publishes this concept as a custom field, but the MV COMPUTES it (list_price / lot_size_acres) instead of reading the CF value. Measured 2026-07-31 on the 1,903 serving rows carrying both: agrees within 1% on 1,879, diverges by more than 10% on 12 (worst 108.3%), and is absent on 6,894 rows we can compute. Same derived-at-source treatment price_per_sqft gets; 8,856 serving rows carry a computable value.

pricePerSqft.resolutionReason: Computed by us at ingest (list price / living area) into the bare price_per_sqft column — the MLS's own 'List Price per SqFt' custom field is not our source. P5 long-tail tranche 2026-07-30: 7,277 live MV rows.

priceReduced.resolutionReason: Computed from our own price-history capture (prev_list_price > list_price) — not a listing metadata field.
